revenue_growth.source: Assumption: revenue fell 5.2% in FY2024 and 7.5% in FY2025 (filed figures); assume a modest further decline in FY2026, then stabilisation and about 2% growth, in line with inflation, with flat commodity prices.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: EBIT margins were 8.8%, 5.9% and 6.1% in FY2023-25 (filed EBIT / revenue). 7% is slightly above the 3-year average of 6.9%.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: Damodaran Europe Oil/Gas (Integrated) effective tax rate of 40.3% (dataset 2026-01-05).

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: D&A was 8.0%, 8.6% and 8.9% of revenue in FY2023-25 (filed). 9% is in line with the latest year.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: capex was 9.3%, 9.0% and 10.6% of revenue in FY2023-25 (filed). 10% is close to the 3-year average.

wacc.source: Assumption. EUR 10Y AAA yield 3.266% (ECB, 2026-11-05); Italy ERP 6.69% (Damodaran); Europe integrated oil unlevered beta 0.406 relevered at D/E about 0.19 gives a CAPM WACC of about 5.9%. That is judged too low for a commodity-exposed company with Baa2 country risk, so 7.5% is used.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run euro-area inflation of about 2% and below the 10Y risk-free rate of 3.27%.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 28,502 (borrowings_noncurrent 20,139 + short-term borrowings 4,929 + current portion of long-term 3,434) - cash 8,100; no short-term investments reported. ESEF BUCRF72VH5RBN7X3VL35-2025-12-31-ESEF-IT-0. Excludes leases.

diluted_shares.source: Not found: weighted diluted shares are not tagged in the Eni ESEF data (null). Not filled from memory. The reviewer should take the figure from the annual report.
